Introducing Model X

Today we are releasing Model X, an open-weight language model with 8 billion parameters that runs on a single consumer graphics card thanks to 4-bit quantization.

Model X was trained on 15 trillion tokens of multilingual data, including a large share of French, German and Spanish text, and supports a context window of 128,000 tokens.

On reasoning benchmarks, Model X matches models twice its size, while its latency stays below 50 milliseconds per token on recent hardware. The weights are published under the Apache 2.0 license.

We are also releasing evaluation code and a technical report describing the data pipeline, the training recipe and the safety tests performed before the release.
